svg.title: 7-Block Neural-Symbolic Pipeline
svg.text: Block I: Search-based Mission Graph Gen.
Block IV: Latent diffusion (U-Net backbone & attention stack)
Block V: LogicNet steering (gradient bias during sampling)
Note: soft steering, not a hard constraint. Active only when logic_guidance_scale > 0
Inference scales are config-driven (see configs/zelda_hmolqd.yaml); typical runtime examples vary by experiment.
Fast sampler and masked-room branches support distinct runtime parameter paths.
